aspect_ratio.description: Target aspect ratio for the generated image. Use 1:1 when nothing in the request implies an orientation.

nsfw_result.description: Image safety classification. Use forbidden for minor sexual content only: CSAM, sexual content involving minors, sexualized minors, underage nudity, or facilitation of that content. Use adult for adult-only sexual content, gore, violence, horror, war, generic unsafe themes, or ambiguous non-CSAM content.
